files.subscribers/README.txt:
Newsletter subscribers, autumn.

The subscriber list gives each subscriber with the number of mailings a year they asked for.
Tables in the database:
  mailing_preferences(id, subscriber, region, mailings)

Each row of mailing_preferences is one subscriber as held by the mailing system.
